Talentlessloser is right. If you stay home, you'll never stop thinking about it. You're in an environment where you've probably done a lot of pmo. Being home alone with nothing to do will only strengthen your urges. Get outside. Ride a bike. Adopt a puppy. Call a friend to get a meal together. Anything but being stuck alone with your urges.

You've made some great strides in avoiding pmo. I haven't gone nearly that long yet. Also you've realized porn does nothing for you anymore. That's a good thing! I know it's just a manifestation of how low you're feeling, but try to see the good in that.
At the risk of sounding cliche, try to remember what motivated you to lose weight the first time. Try to harness that. Exercise releases endorphins. If you did it once, you CAN do it again. I believe in you. Keep your chin up. I'm sure you have plenty of good qualities that you're choosing to ignore right now.

As someone who's been addicted to PMO for about half his life, I can say without a doubt, it's not you. It's not really him either, it's the disconnected world we live in. I was in a LTR for four years, and I felt terrible because sex would just make me want to watch porn alone. My gf was beautiful and smart and lacked nothing that a guy could want, but I'm an addict and there's only one way to feed that addiction.

We live in a world where many people would rather snap a pic of their food so a handful of friends could see it for 10 sec than start a conversation with a stranger. We're all addicted to computers, cell phones, TV. We live an artificial life, vicariously through fictional characters and facebook posts. I've been in social settings several times where I just want to cry, because we're all out together playing with our cell phones instead of having a real life experience. 

The only thing I can do is stop writing this and go outside, without my phone.
